blip_cause_pooled.calendar: NYSE closures, rule-derived: New Year, MLK, Presidents, Good Friday, Memorial, Juneteenth (from 2022), Independence, Labor, Thanksgiving, Christmas -- plus the three scheduled 13:00 early closes
blip_cause_pooled.hk_calendar: HKEX calendar, measured on the HSI daily series (no bar = Hong Kong did not trade; a bar whose turnover is under 60% of its own trailing-20 median = a half day with no closing valuation). Statutory HK holidays follow the lunar calendar and the exchange also shuts for typhoons, so no rule set names this calendar -- the index does.
blip_cause_pooled.nav_move_basis: largest / 90th percentile over the legs' one-row stamps
blip_cause_pooled.nav_move_ratio_basis: median over legs of each leg's own median

ruler.premium: panel close / the newest unit NAV stamped strictly before that close - 1
ruler.status_join: 申购状态 printed on the NAV stamp the premium used
ruler.status_source: EM fund_etf_fund_info_em column 申购状态 (dropped by the NAV cache)

summary_sentence: 5/5 legs show no open primary subscription anywhere in coverage; hard-suspended on their latest stamp: 513100; exchange-only on their latest stamp: 159501, 513690, 159577, 159263; the 830 hard-suspended sessions are 141 runs (116 of them a single NAV row); with the 116 one-row valuation gaps removed the block still sits wider on 513100 and not on 513690, 159577; 159501 has no real suspension left at all; 513100's gap sits in its single 435-session run (own gap +4.28) while its other 47 runs read +0.06; the single-row runs are not spread over the calendar: Tue carries 51% of them against 20% of priced sessions (chance 3e-13), so a one-row word is a word printed that session, not a fund policy; what those one-row words are is a valuation gap, not an announcement: 116/116 of them suspend 赎回 on the same row, they move the NAV by 0.10 of a normal session (median), and 89/116 sit on a session the NYSE calendar explains against 3.0% of ordinary sessions (25.5x); closed channel is consistent with a standing premium, not a verdict on it
